title: docs(pm-dispatch): a project-run seat form beside the Routine form — the seat post as a stub, the dispatch order in the card thread, event wake plus one patrol per project, 项目总监 → 总监席

_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D4DhDnco8yuU89yAoN1Eq5n)_

Fixes #25379

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读(草稿)

- **改了什么**:pm-dispatch 技能里加一种「项目席」形态,与 Routine 席并列:席位会话是车道项目的线程时,座位贴降为存根(只留别的账号要读的四项:在座账号与项目、上任时刻、热文件串行队、指针行,外加可选撞墙注记),姿态、台账、班次叙事与轮报住项目;派发令由协调者写进卡线程开场消息,不再落共享目录;唤醒 = 每张卡 PR 的订阅事件 + 每项目一个 2–4 小时巡查 routine,不再有自绑 cron、`send_later` 链与跨墙定时器链;轮报 = 卡线程清单,五项健康指标进总监项目的每日摘要;「项目总监」改称「总监席」,GitHub 的 org Project 改称「看板」,并在入口表定义「车道项目」与「总监项目」。
- **为什么改**:您 2026-10-23 在「车队机制迁往 Projects」线程的原话:「同意，你现在就立卡派发处理。」(对调研备忘推荐字母 1B 2A 3B 4B 5B 与第 9 节命名的同意)。
- **风险与代价(含回滚)**:纯规则文本,八个文件行数全部净零、每行 ≤120 字节,无上限抬高;一次 revert 可回。两处要您知道:① 卡上第 3 项「线程开起前先命名分支」实测做不到——分支由平台在线程建立那一刻指定(本线程拿到的是 `claude/project-thread-hxtlri`),协调者只能在线程建起之后读到它,不能事先命名;本 PR 不写第 3 项,照派发令交席位汇入决裁批。② 为付行数删掉了三条 Routine 席专用规则(自绑 cron、`send_later` 加速器、跨墙每小时 cron 链),正是卡上点名的付账行;维护者在 UI 建的 Routine 席不受影响。
- **席位意见**:(席位复核后填)
- **你要做的(一个动作)**:等席位契约复核 PASS、CI 全绿后说一句「可以落地」;第 3 项的形状在决裁批里选一个字母(选项见下)。

## What changed

Eight files under `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/**`, rule text only; every file lands at the same line count it had, every edited line is at or under 120 bytes, no ratchet ceiling moves (so `scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs` is untouched).

The rule after the change, as the card states it: GitHub keeps what another account reads (six-state labels, assignee, `Claim:`/`Release:`, the seat stub, the PR and its ACCEPT, the ruling record); the project keeps the working layer (posture, ledger, orders, round reports, memory). It is written as the two 〈座位贴协议〉 lines, not restated elsewhere.

Acceptance checks on this head: `git grep -n '项目总监' -- .claude/skills` → no hit; `git grep -n '总监席' -- .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md` → L56 (the `director` row) and L274–L276.

## Item 3 is NOT written — `needs_decision`, for the maintainer's ruling batch

The card's item 3 (「branch named before the thread opens」: the seat claims first with the `Claim:` naming the branch the coordinator will give the thread, then asks for the thread) rests on the coordinator being able to name a project thread's branch. Measured on this very thread (A2 below): it cannot. The branch is platform-assigned at thread creation (`claude/project-thread-` + a random suffix; 27 such heads on `origin`), the coordinator's opening message carried none, and the thread may push only that branch. So the 〈卡线程〉 handshake lines (thread reports its branch → seat writes assignee, `pm:dispatched` and the `Claim:` → thread starts) are left exactly as they are, and this PR writes neither the claim-first order nor the probe-push drop. Options as the dispatch order asks, ⛔ none picked here:

- **A. Coordinator reads, seat claims, thread verifies.** The coordinator reads the new thread's branch from its session record the moment it is spawned (`get_session` on the child lists `outcomes[].git_info.branches` before any push — measured) and hands it to the seat in the same stroke; the seat claims; the thread's first act stays 「verify the newest `Claim:` names my branch」 and it starts as soon as the claim is up. Cost: one read per thread; the thread still waits for the seat, usually less than today because the read beats the thread's own report.
- **B. Today's handshake minus the probe push.** The thread reports its branch and waits; the seat claims; the thread starts. The empty-branch push (`os-dev.md` rule 1) is dropped for card threads because the branch is platform-designated and the push route is the harness's. Cost: zero protocol change on the seat side; the 5–10 minute wait the card measured stays. (The probe-push drop touches `.claude/agents/os-dev.md`, outside this card's file surface either way.)
- **C. Claim first with the branch line filled later.** The seat claims with `Branch: pending` and the thread's first report fills it by a body edit of the claim comment. Cost: a claim comment that is edited after it is written, which the claim protocol (「认领评论时间戳是唯一仲裁」) does not foresee.

## The PM's mechanism assumptions, measured

- **A1 (hot files; three seat PRs unmerged)** — holds; all three are still open (`#25348` at `2bf0113`, `#25255` at `3e6e35e`, `#25247` at `d062675`). This PR starts from `main` at `448374d` and touches none of their hunks: `#25348`'s SKILL.md L30/L106/L212–L222/L234/L264/L267/L276, `seat-lifecycle.md` L69, `dispatch-runbook.md` L57/L77/L115/L146, `execution-duties.md` L103, `contract-review.md`, `triage-duties.md`, `lanes/director.md` L13–L24 and L45–L60 — not touched; `#25255`'s SKILL.md L57 insertion (the `coordinator` row) and `dispatch-runbook.md` L136 — not touched; `#25247`'s 〈域车道〉 table and `lanes/*` other than the two one-line renames — not touched. Two known overlaps, both trivial: `#25255` deletes SKILL.md L274, which this PR only renames (the merge takes the deletion); `#25247` and `#25348` move SKILL.md's count (317 and 319) while this PR leaves it at 318 under the 319 ceiling, so whichever lands last re-measures. The `coordinator.md` pointer and the 「项目协调者」→「协调者」 rename inside it wait for `#25255` (a follow-up commit on this branch after the seat says it landed). The one 〈卡线程〉 word that goes stale with item 2 — 「派发令文件」 in the 席位交候选 line — sits beside `#25255`'s L136 hunk and is left for the same follow-up.
- **A2 (can the coordinator name the branch?)** — disproved. `get_session` on this thread shows the branch `claude/project-thread-hxtlri` in `session_context.outcomes[].git_repository.git_info.branches` at creation (04:51:59Z); the coordinator's opening note named no branch; `git ls-remote` had no such head until this thread pushed it; the suffix appears in neither the thread id nor the session id. So the branch is readable after spawn, not nameable before it — item 3 goes to the ruling batch as above.
- **A3 (SKILL.md 319/319 once `#25348` lands)** — holds and is respected: SKILL.md stays at 318 lines (two lines replaced in place, four edited in place), so `#25348`'s pointer line still fits. No re-wrap used as payment; the two lines removed are the two mechanisms the card names.
- **A4 (`check:pm-skill-id-lint`)** — holds; the operating text names rules by file and section only; 87 files clean.

Every one was run in this worktree with its exit code captured before any pipe and recorded as `COMMAND :: exit CODE`, then reconciled with `--ran`: 20 derived, 20 run, 20 × `exit 0`, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN (`✓ dispatch-gates --ran`). The first pass on `2b1450c` had one `exit 3` — `pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint run check:doc-formula-expressions`, a PREREQUISITE (the `@objectstack/formula` and `@objectstack/lint` builds are absent in a fresh worktree) — cleared by building those two packages under `scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh` and re-running; the full 20-command pass on this head is the one recorded. The four the dispatch order names: `pnpm check:pm-skill-ratchet` ✓ (declared cross-file moves 2, total ceilings down 486, no row moved), `pnpm check:pm-skill-id-lint` ✓ (87 files clean), `pnpm check:skill-frame-sync` ✓, `pnpm check:skill-frame-freshness` ✓ (local-only family; current with `origin/main`). ## Acceptance notes

- The body's first line is the HTML-comment attribution block the project session requires; `os-dev.md` 〈干净收尾〉 forbids HTML comments in GitHub text. Measured on the sibling PRs of this project, the relay read-back keeps it byte for byte. Reported as a deviation, not hidden.
- `references/cross-repo-coordination.md` 规则 5 still says 「org Project 只是维护者的聚合视图」; the card's naming item points only at `rest-channel.md`, and the claim's file surface does not list this file, so it is left as is — a one-line rename (「看板(org Project)只是聚合视图」, 114 bytes, line-neutral) for the seat to order or fold into the follow-up commit.
- The card's item 4 names the patrol's work as 「the collection step of `execution-duties.md` (unlock scan, hold release, stale premise, awaiting-landing list, wall note)」; those five are the standby items `seat-lifecycle.md` 〈停止条件与待命〉 already enumerates, so the new line says 「跑各车道待命项」 and points at nothing new.
- Work was done in a linked worktree (`../objectstack-issue-25379`) on the designated branch; the primary checkout was left detached at `d12e650`. The empty-branch push was made before the first edit, as `os-dev.md` rule 1 asks today.
- The commit trailer pair is the model-free pair the pre-push hook requires.
